message.content:
具有多個細胞核的細胞稱為 **多核細胞（multinucleated cell）**。在人體中，最常見的多核細胞類型包括：

| 細胞類型 | 主要功能 | 典型位置 |
|----------|----------|----------|
| **骨吸收細胞（Osteoclast）** | 分解骨組織，調節鈣質代謝 | 骨骼 |
| **同步子細胞（Syncytiotrophoblast）** | 形成胎盤，促進營養物質交換 | 胎盤 |
| **骨骼肌纖維（Skeletal muscle fiber）** | 收縮，產生運動 | 肌肉 |
| **巨噬細胞（Macrophage）** | 吞噬病原體，清除碎片 | 免疫系統 |

這些細胞之所以能夠多核，是因為它們在發育過程中經歷了細胞融合或細胞分裂後未完成細胞質分裂（karyokinesis）等特殊機制。

They want the name of a cell type with multiple nuclei. In biology, multinucleated cells include skeletal muscle fibers (myocytes), osteoclasts, syncytiotrophoblasts, some fungi, etc. The most common is skeletal muscle cells (muscle fibers). Also osteoclasts are multinucleated giant cells. Syncytiotrophoblasts are multinucleated cells in placenta. So answer: "多核細胞" or "多核肌細胞" or "骨吸收細胞" etc. Provide explanation.
